name: Constantine I
title: Roman emperor (moved capital to Constantinople)
note: Edict of Milan. Moved capital in 330. Founder of Byzantium

name: Theodora
title: Empress (Justinian I)
note: Former actress. Co-ruled with the emperor. Suppressed the Nika revolt

name: Irene
title: Eastern Roman empress
note: Restored icon veneration (Second Council of Nicaea)

name: Alexios I
title: Eastern Roman emperor
note: Komnenos dynasty. Cooperated with the Crusaders

name: John II
title: Eastern Roman emperor
note: Great emperor of the Komnenos dynasty

name: Michael VIII
title: Eastern Roman emperor
note: Recaptured Constantinople from the Latin Empire

name: Constantine XI
title: Last Eastern Roman emperor
note: Died fighting at the Fall of Constantinople. End of Byzantium
